decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this consent.
Condition : 2 - All new internal and external works, including works of making good, shall match the original work in both type, colour and dimensions of materials and in detailed execution.

Condition : 3 - Any areas of external brickwork/paintwork/masonry required to be created or replaced in accordance with the approved plans shall match the existing brickwork, paintwork and masonry in brick colour and size, mortar colour and pointing and bonding detail.

Condition : 4 - A description of the steps and works to be taken and carried out in relation to the repair and alteration of the existing timber frame, including any additional elements to be inserted, shall be submitted to and approved by the Secretary of State before any work is commenced.

Condition : 5 - A scheme indicating the provision to be made for disabled people to gain access to the house shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Scretary of State before the development hereby permitted is commenced.  The agreed scheme shall be implemented before the development hereby permitted is brought into use.

Condition : 6 - This consent does not permit the demolition or dismantling of any part of the building, or the removal of any internal feature, floor, wall or ceiling surface, except in so far as the alterations and extension hereby approved necessitate the removal of certain parts of the existing structure as specifically shown on the approved drawings.
description: Alterations to front entry gate and side gate, removal of water tanks from attic and removal of first floor bathroom to increase internal public space and minor internal works including some re-painting
